reviewer: ChatGPT GPT-6.2 — implementer self-review (same-session; not independent)

reviewScope.summary: Scoped owner-authorized language, presentation and navigation improvement across Git & GitHub Pathways M01–M07. Reviewed beginner teaching, natural Bokmål, Git semantics, privacy, accessibility, content delivery and persistence boundaries.
evidence: Inspected canonical curriculum sources for all seven modules, the shared lesson renderer, Git-specific and inherited Norwegian UI copy, the existing release gate and affected browser selectors.

Compared original master cc502c6 and candidate e128049 generated module assets: 47 lessons, 29 revised lessons, 54 changed blocks; 92 command blocks have identical executable text, expected output and error fields. All lesson IDs, block order, skill/unit metadata, 113 exercise IDs, optionality, evaluator modes and answer keys are unchanged.

Four existing exercise content hashes change because their wording changes (M01 E05/E06/E07 and M05 E19); the existing history-retention behaviour applies. No learner storage migration, new proof mechanism, or assessment gate.

Verified original asset/source hashes during regeneration and checked all final rendered module prompt/text blocks for the specified banned terms; none remain. Same-origin hashed assets, catalogue and offline manifest updated together.

Existing keyboard navigation regression exercises the actual reference target and saved progress; removed its unnecessary exact prose assertion. Browser, formatter, source exporter and release validation have not been executed in this environment; hosted GitHub checks must pass.

adversarialFindings.description: Ambiguous references, crowded instructions, misleading completion/saved-answer text and unnecessarily clinical practice wording made learning harder.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Named the previous staging section with a direct link; separated explanations, actions and results; simplified Git-only copy and kept self-reporting and the optional filename check.

adversarialFindings.description: Editorial changes to four exercise records produce new content hashes; existing submissions are retained as history rather than counted as current answers.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Preserved all identifiers, evaluator rules and completion state; no new migration or certification logic. The established content-hash rule remains in force.

retrospective.summary: PASS for scoped implementer review: no concrete unresolved material issue found in source and generated-asset comparison. Hosted engineering validation is still required. No independent review or routine owner approval requested.
